results.primary_cause: No verifiable external source was identified confirming or contradicting the exact specialty DRAM/NOR/NAND pricing and utilization driver; current evidence is insufficient to distinguish an industry-wide cycle from company-specific conditions.

Available reporting indicates evolving storage demand and NAND-controller relevance, but does not provide sufficiently reliable, time-consistent evidence covering NAND pricing, SSD/controller/module demand, and inventory together; contradictory exact-driver evidence remains unresolved.

supporting_evidence.claim: Phison Electronics is described as a NAND flash controller supplier responding to evolving storage demand as data growth and SSD adoption affect consumer-device and data-center storage requirements.
supporting_evidence.source_title: Phison Electronics Corp highlights its NAND controller role as demand for storage keeps evolving

results.primary_cause: Evidence shows stronger dry-bulk freight conditions and Capesize demand, but industry commentary also attributes part of the 2026 strength to forced rerouting and warns of a future supply glut; the persistence and commodity-volume breadth of the exact freight cycle are therefore unresolved.

supporting_evidence.claim: The Baltic Dry Index reportedly reached 2,732 points on July 31, 2026, rising approximately 9.2% during July, with conditions varying across dry-bulk segments.
supporting_evidence.source_title: HTCO Highlights Strengthening Dry Bulk Market as BDI Rises Approximately 9.2% in July and Shipping Equities Gain Investor Attention

supporting_evidence.claim: A key dry-bulk freight-rate measure reached its highest level since December 2023, attributed to rising Capesize demand and tightening vessel supply.
supporting_evidence.source_title: Dry-Bulk Shipping Rates Hit Two-Year High on Capesize Demand

counter_evidence.claim: BIMCO warned that apparent 2026 dry-bulk market strength was substantially artificial, driven by forced rerouting, and forecast that the effect would reverse alongside a potential 2027 supply glut.
counter_evidence.source_title: Dry bulk shipping faces 2027 supply glut: BIMCO warns Hormuz rerouting boost will reverse
